text:
maria: Seeing 403s on dedicated GPU job controller when trying to mount model-kv secrets after yesterday's RBAC roll.
sam: Same here. Job create fails with 403 from the admissions webhook: \n```
E0402 15:12:03.421345 1 controller.go:234] failed to create pod: pods \"model-run-42\" is forbidden: User \"system:serviceaccount:infra:deploy-bot\" cannot create resource \"pods\" in API group \"\" in the namespace \"gpu-pool-eta\"
```
jordan: Also seeing KMS decrypt failures from the keyserver when the inference runtime tries to unwrap envelopes. Error: \"permission denied for key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/kr-1/cryptoKeys/ck-1: iam.permissionDenied\". Could be the same consolidation change.
lee: Quick check — I think the deploy-role slimdown removed a couple of bindings for both k8s Secrets and the KMS decrypt principal. We consolidated a few service accounts yesterday and the IAM merge probably dropped the workload identity entry.
maria: Audit logs oddity: I can't find any impersonation records for deploy-bot in the audit logs around the deploy time. Either the requests are being proxied by the controller (so subject shows as controller SA) or the audit sink filter dropped them. Can someone run a logging query? Example: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type=k8s_cluster AND jsonPayload.auditLog.methodName:Create AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:deploy-bot@' --limit 50`.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2025-092 created (sev: P2) — assigned to @jordan, @maria.
sam: Mitigation idea: add a temporary Role in gpu namespaces that grants minimal secrets access to the deploy-bot SA and add kms.cryptoKeyDecrypter to the KMS key IAM for the workload identity. Then tighten later.
lee: Proposed Role (apply to namespaces gpu-pool-*):\n```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: deploy-min-secrets
rules:
- apiGroups: [\"\"]
  resources: [\"secrets\"]
  verbs: [\"get\", \"list\"]
```
and RoleBinding:\n```bash
kubectl create rolebinding deploy-min-secrets-binding \\
  --role=deploy-min-secrets --serviceaccount=infra:deploy-bot \\
  --namespace=gpu-pool-eta
```
maria: For KMS: add IAM binding to allow the workload identity used by deploy-bot: \n```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding ck-1 \\
  --keyring=kr-1 --location=global \\
  --member=\"serviceAccount:workload-identity-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" \\
  --role=\"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter\"
```
jordan: I'll own the KMS change + audit verification. Sam, can you do the quick namespace rolebinding to unblock queued jobs? After that we'll re-run failing jobs and verify.
oncall-tim: I'll run the rolebinding in gpu-pool-eta now, will paste results. ETA ~5m. :thumbsup:
security-bot: Reminder: create a short ACL PR to capture the exact privileges added, include least-priv tests and add to the RBAC roll checklist; tag `security-review`.
sam: Done — patched rolebinding applied to gpu-pool-eta, pasted logs: `rolebinding.rbac.authorization.k8s.io/deploy-min-secrets-binding created`.
oncall-tim: KMS IAM binding applied by jordan (operation id op-34412). Verified decrypt success on test job: `ok`.
maria: Jobs that were failing are now moving to RUNNING. No new 403s observed in the last 10m. Good.
jordan: Root cause summary (short): when we consolidated cluster IAM and trimmed duplicate bindings in the consolidation PR 5243, a workload-identity mapping and a secrets get permission used by the GPU job controller were unintentionally removed. That made deploy-bot unable to request secrets and decrypt envelopes. Audit didn't show impersonation because the controller path masked the original principal — need to enrich audit sink filter.
lee: Action items: 1) revert temporary broadening after narrow PR 2) add unit test for RBAC slimdown (simulate kubecontroller flows) 3) add audit sink rule to capture proxied principals 4) postmortem owner: jordan.
maria: tagging postmortem ticket PM-2025-68 and closing incident once we have the narrow PR ready.
jordan: I'll file the PR today and include the KMS IAM delta + the Role/RoleBinding delta with a note on scope. Will also add an integration test that exercises secrets access for the deploy SA.
maria: thanks everyone — leaving notes in the incident doc. If anything regresses ping here.
